headlines.description: — Griffin Conine hit a go-ahead pinch-hit homer in the eighth, Otto Lopez, Heriberto Hernández and Xavier Edwards each had two RBI, and the Miami Marlins rallied to beat the Philadelphia Phillies 8-6 on Wednesday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Conine puts Marlins ahead for good with eighth inning pinch-hit homer, Marlins defeat Phillies 8-6

headlines.description: — Eduardo Rodríguez pitched eight shutout innings, Gabriel Moreno hit a two-run homer and the Arizona Diamondbacks beat the Pittsburgh Pirates 3-0 on Wednesday, clinching the three-game series.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rodríguez goes 8 innings, Moreno hits 2-run homer as Diamondbacks blank Pirates 3-0

events.name: Toronto Blue Jays at Washington Nationals

headlines.description: — Trey Yesavage allowed one run in 6 2/3 innings, Kazuma Okamoto went 3-for-5 with two RBI and two runs, and the Toronto Blue Jays defeated the Washington Nationals 5-2 on Wednesday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Yesavage throws 6 2/3 innings, Okamoto has three hits in Blue Jays' 5-2 win over Nationals

events.name: Atlanta Braves at New York Mets

headlines.description: — Carson Benge hit a tie-breaking RBI double in the seventh inning Wednesday, lifting the New York Mets to a 3-2 victory over the Atlanta Braves in the opener of a doubleheader.
headlines.shortLinkText: Benge's tie-breaking hit lifts Mets to third straight win, a 3-2 victory over the Braves

headlines.description: — Colton Cowser hit a tiebreaking single in the 12th inning, capping the Baltimore Orioles' rally from a seven-run deficit to beat the Tigers 10-9 on Wednesday and spoil
headlines.shortLinkText: Orioles rally from 7-0 down to beat Tigers in 12 innings, spoiling Skubal's possible farewell

events.name: Milwaukee Brewers at San Francisco Giants

headlines.description: — Luis Arraez had four of San Francisco's 17 hits, Daniel Susac hit his first two homers in the majors and the Giants routed the Brewers 16-3 on Wednesday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Arraez and Susac help the Giants rout the Brewers 16-3

events.name: Colorado Rockies at San Diego Padres

headlines.description: — Jackson Merrill, Luis Rengifo and Gavin Sheets had RBI Griffin Canning and five relievers turned in a strong bullpen outing as the San Diego Padres beat the Colorado Rockies 3-1 on Wednesday to take both games of the short series.
headlines.shortLinkText: Canning and 5 relievers shut down Colorado as Padres beat Rockies 3-1

events.name: Texas Rangers at Tampa Bay Rays

headlines.description: — Yandy Diaz and Ryan Vilade homered in the first inning and five pitchers combined for a four-hitter as the Tampa Bay Rays beat the Texas Rangers 3-0 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Diaz, Vilade homers and a 4-hitter in a bullpen game helps Rays beat Rangers 3-0

headlines.description: — Kyle Manzardo homered and drove in two runs, Joey Cantillo pitched four scoreless innings and the Cleveland Guardians beat the Cincinnati Reds 6-1 Wednesday night to claim the season series from their in-state rivals.
headlines.shortLinkText: Manzardo's HR and 2 RBIs, Cantillo's strong outing power Guardians to a 6-1 win over the Reds

events.name: Atlanta Braves at New York Mets

headlines.description: — Chris Sale struck out nine and limited New York to two hits in six innings and the Atlanta Braves beat the Mets 1-0 on Wednesday to split a day/night doubleheader.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sale dominates as Braves beat Mets 1-0 to split doubleheader

events.name: Kansas City Royals at Minnesota Twins

headlines.description: — Randy Dobnak pitched seven scoreless innings for his first major league victory in five years as the Kansas City Royals beat the Minnesota Twins 4-0 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Randy Dobnak picks up first win in 5 years as Royals beat Twins 4-0

events.name: New York Yankees at Chicago White Sox

headlines.description: — Edgar Quero had an RBI single in the 12th inning to give the Chicago White Sox a 6-5 victory over the New York Yankees on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: White Sox outlast the Yankees 6-5 in the 12th on Quero's RBI single

events.name: Chicago Cubs at St. Louis Cardinals

headlines.description: — Iván Herrera had a two-run double with one out in the 10th inning to give the St. Louis Cardinals a 3-2 comeback victory over the Chicago Cubs on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Herrera doubles as Cardinals rally to beat Cubs 3-2 in 10 innings

events.name: Houston Astros at Los Angeles Angels

headlines.description: — Cam Smith gave Houston the lead with a two-run double in the sixth inning, Yainer Diaz and Jeremy Peña hit solo homers and the Astros beat the Los Angeles Angels 7-4 on Wednesday night for a three-game sweep.
headlines.shortLinkText: Astros beat Angels 7-4 for a 3-game sweep

events.name: Boston Red Sox at Athletics Athletics

headlines.description: — Andrew Monasterio hit a two-run home run in the 10th inning and the Boston Red Sox held on to beat the Athletics 4-2 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Red Sox beat the A's 4-2 on Monasterio's 2-run homer in the 10th

events.name: Seattle Mariners at Los Angeles Dodgers

headlines.description: — Eric Lauer tossed one-hit ball over six scoreless innings, Andy Pages homered, and the Los Angeles Dodgers beat the Seattle Mariners 4-2 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Eric Lauer stifles the Mariners in the Dodgers' 4-2 victory
